$comment: AgentNotify harness example for Claude Code. Merge the hooks object into your real settings file (~/.claude/settings.json for you, or <repo>/.claude/settings.json for a project) and replace HOOK_DIR with the folder holding agentnotify_hook.py. Prefer `agentnotify install-harness claude` so the merge is idempotent and your other hooks survive. The hook only notifies; it never approves or blocks — exit 0 always.
